d: Bill talks about being sick, Daylight Saving Time messing him up, a Halloween memory he has with Jimmy, their text chain with John Mulaney & Fred Armisen, having to play football growing up because he’s from Oklahoma, his high school yearbook photo, being in the new Netflix Documentary SCTV: The Greatest Show You’ve Never Heard Of, starring in The Cat in the Hat movie, his kids being funny, and doing a guest spot on Abbott Elementary.
